draft_args.prompt: [Look: Mounted-camera look, 1990s dashcam footage.] [Through a windshield at night a shopping cart rolls slowly across an empty road; at 4 s a raccoon-costumed adult mascot chases it; at 8 s the cart stops at the curb.] Single shot: medium shot, 35mm, eye level, static camera, one continuous 10 s take. Eyelines: everyone looks at the product and each other, never into the lens; faces in profile or three-quarter. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera. Parody brands only.]
